Client.title: Client
Client.description: Represents a client with whom contracts are established. Stores essential contact information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Client entity.

name.description: The full name or company name of the client.

email.description: The primary email address of the client for communication and reminders.

phoneNumber.description: The contact phone number of the client.

address.description: The physical address of the client.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the client record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the client record was last updated.

Contract.title: Contract
Contract.description: Represents a legal agreement or contract between the user and a client. Includes details, terms, and status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Contract entity.

clientId.description: Reference to the Client associated with this contract. (Relationship: Client 1:N Contract)

title.description: The descriptive title or name of the contract.

description.description: Detailed clauses and terms of the contract.

status.description: The current status of the contract (e.g., 'Draft', 'Active', 'Pending Approval', 'Completed', 'Canceled').

startDate.description: The official start date of the contract.

endDate.description: The official end date of the contract.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the contract was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the contract was last updated.

ContractEvent.title: ContractEvent
ContractEvent.description: Represents a specific event, deadline, or meeting associated with a contract, used for scheduling and reminders.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ContractEvent entity.

contractId.description: Reference to the Contract this event belongs to. (Relationship: Contract 1:N ContractEvent)

description.description: A description detailing the purpose or specifics of the event.

dateTime.description: The specific date and time for this event, crucial for reminders.

isReminderSent.description: Flag indicating whether a reminder has already been sent for this event.

remindToClient.description: Flag indicating if a reminder should be sent to the client for this event.

remindToUser.description: Flag indicating if a reminder should be sent to the app user for this event.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the event was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the event was last updated.

definition.description: Stores client details associated with a specific user. Access is restricted to the owning user (`userId`) determined by the path.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns this client.

params.name: clientId
params.description: The unique identifier for the client.

definition.description: Stores contract details for a specific client, owned by a specific user. The `clientId` field within the document must match the path parameter `{clientId}` for data integrity. Access is restricted to the owning user (`userId`) determined by the path.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns this contract.

params.name: clientId
params.description: The unique identifier of the client to whom this contract belongs.

params.name: contractId
params.description: The unique identifier for the contract.

definition.description: Stores scheduled events and reminders related to a specific contract and client, all owned by a specific user. The `contractId` field within the document must match the path parameter `{contractId}` for data integrity. Access is restricted to the owning user (`userId`) determined by the path.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns this contract event.

params.name: clientId
params.description: The unique identifier of the client associated with the parent contract.

params.name: contractId
params.description: The unique identifier of the contract to which this event belongs.

params.name: eventId
params.description: The unique identifier for the contract event.

firestore.reasoning:
The recommended Firestore structure for ContractTime prioritizes strict data ownership and authorization independence through a deeply nested, path-based hierarchy. All data—Clients, Contracts, and ContractEvents—are directly scoped under the authenticated user's ID. This results in paths like `users/{userId}/clients/{clientId}/contracts/{contractId}/events/{eventId}`.

**Authorization Independence:** This structure inherently achieves authorization independence. The `userId` is explicitly present in the path for every document. This means that security rules can always determine the owner of a document (e.g., `request.auth.uid == userId`) without needing to perform `get()` operations on parent documents (like `clients/{clientId}` or `contracts/{contractId}`). This allows for atomic operations (transactions/batches) and significantly simplifies security rules, as the authorization context is always self-contained within the document's path.

**Support for QAPs (Rules are not Filters):** The structural segregation principle is fully applied here. Each collection (e.g., `/users/{userId}/clients`, `/users/{userId}/clients/{clientId}/contracts`) contains documents that exclusively belong to the `userId` specified in the path. This ensures a homogeneous security posture within each collection. When a user queries for clients, contracts, or events, their query is naturally constrained to their owned data by the `userId` in the path. For example, a query to `users/ABC/clients` will only return clients owned by user `ABC`. This design makes `list` operations inherently secure and prevents users from accidentally or maliciously querying data they don't own, as the rules will simply deny access if the `userId` in the path doesn't match `request.auth.uid`.
